scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The analytic proof is primary evidence; the included finite verifier is a sanity check only. No independent validation is claimed.
limitations: Asymptotics are for each fixed derivative order and fixed Jordan size.
The result quantifies polynomial amplification and does not assert convergence for a defective dominant eigenvalue.
Two plausible related preprints were not fully inspected; this residual literature risk is disclosed.

title: Variance-controlled Jordan growth for random-walk momentum polynomials
